function.name: memory
function.description: Your persistent long-term memory box about the boss (Error404). Use action=save to store a durable fact (preferences, projects, people, decisions, important context, how they like things done). Use action=search with a query to recall stored facts; the query can be a guess or only an approximation — matching is fuzzy. Use action=list to dump everything, action=get for a single key, or action=forget to delete a key. Always search before claiming you do not know something you might have stored.

action.description: save, search, list, get, or forget. Default search.

query.description: Text to recall. Can be approximate or a guessed phrase; keys and values are matched fuzzily.

key.description: Short snake_case memory key for save, get, or forget.

value.description: The fact to store for save.

importance.description: 1 to 10 importance for save. Higher is recalled more often. Default 5.

limit.description: Maximum results for search or list. Default 10.
